descripcion_geo: Mediterranean Peninsula, heart of the Roman Empire. Rome, its capital, is the final destination of Paul's apostolic journey.
importancia_estrategica: Spiritual capital of the Roman world; Rome as the final goal of Paul and seat of the martyrdom of Peter and Paul.

historias.titulo: Paul appeals to Caesar and sails to Italy
historias.descripcion: Before the court of Festus, Paul appeals to the emperor; He is sent under guard to Rome by sea.

historias.titulo: The shipwreck and arrival in Italy
historias.descripcion: After shipwrecking in Malta, Paul finally arrives in Italy and disembarks in Poteoli.

historias.titulo: Paul in Rome: two years of free preaching
historias.descripcion: In Rome, Paul preaches the kingdom of God under house arrest for two years.

personajes.descripcion: He arrived in Italy as a prisoner; There he wrote letters, preached and was martyred.
According to tradition, he went to Rome and died crucified face down under Nero.
Jews expelled from Rome by Claudius' edict; Paul found them in Corinth.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Rome as the goal and destination of the gospel; his letter to the Romans is the most complete theological treatise in the NT.

cristianismo.descripcion: The book of Acts ends with Paul preaching freely in Rome; The gospel has reached the center of the world.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The book of Acts ends with Paul preaching freely in Rome; The gospel has reached the center of the world.

historias.descripcion: Paul arrives in Rome as a prisoner; The brothers go out to welcome him to the Forum of Celery.

historias.titulo: The letter to the Romans: the gospel for the capital
historias.descripcion: Paul writes the Letter to the Romans before arriving, his most systematic theological work.

historias.titulo: The martyrdom of Peter and Paul in Rome
historias.descripcion: Under Nero, Peter and Paul are martyred in Rome; The blood of the martyrs becomes the seed of the Church.

personajes.descripcion: He arrived in Rome as a prisoner; He preached, wrote and was beheaded.
Martyred in Rome; His tomb in the Vatican is the center of the Catholic Church.
It triggered the first systemic persecution of Christians in Rome after the fire of 64 AD.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Rome is the final destination of the gospel in Acts and the scene of apostolic martyrdom.

cristianismo.descripcion: The book of Acts culminates with Paul preaching freely in the heart of the Roman Empire: the gospel has reached 'to the ends of the earth' (Acts 1:8).
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The book of Acts culminates with Paul preaching freely in the heart of the Roman Empire: the gospel has reached 'to the ends of the earth' (Acts 1:8).
